```{r update_mpxnyc_package, include = FALSE, messages=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
remotes::install_github("KeletsoMakofane/mpxnyc", auth_token = "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")
```

```{r load_libraries, include = FALSE, messages=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(mpxnyc)
library(sf)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)



mpxnyc_colors <- mpxnyc::mpxnyc_colors
attach(mpxnyc_colors)

```

```{r scripts}
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions")
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions/1_data_processing")
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions/2_data_summary")
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions/3_data_extract")
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions/4_plot")
targets::tar_source(files = "R_functions/5_tables")
```

```{r update_data_pipeline, include=FALSE, messages=FALSE, warning = FALSE}


targets::tar_make() # Runs the data pipeline shown in _targets.R


```
